4731 Robert Burns 1759-1796 John Bartlett

 
 
 
NUMBER:
4731
 
AUTHOR:
Robert Burns
 (1759–1796)
 
QUOTATION:
The best laid schemes o’ mice and men
        Gang aft a-gley;
And leave us naught but grief and pain
        For promised joy.
 
ATTRIBUTION:
To a Mouse.
